results.agent_cause: The recent deployment reduced the payment gateway timeout from 5000ms to 3000ms, causing gateway timeouts that resulted in a spike of 5xx errors on /checkout/complete.
results.ground_truth_cause: recent deployment changed payment timeout threshold, causing premature timeouts under load

results.agent_cause: The low cache hit rate (41%) suggests that many requests are hitting the database or slower backend, causing the high p95 latency. No error logs or recent deployments point to a configuration or resource issue rather than a code bug.
results.ground_truth_cause: Redis cache experiencing high memory pressure, causing eviction and cache misses, pushing load to primary database

results.agent_cause: The recent deployment (DEP-4502) updated the auth token validation module, which introduced a startup error causing the readiness probe to fail and the pod to enter a crash loop. This prevented any /auth/login requests from being processed, resulting in a 100% error rate.
results.ground_truth_cause: auth-service pods crashed after a bad deployment introduced a startup error

results.agent_cause: The deployment of the new background job order-reconciliation-worker increased database connection usage, causing the connection pool to reach its maximum (100 connections) and exhaust it during /orders/create requests.
results.ground_truth_cause: newly deployed background job holding database connections without releasing them, exhausting the pool

results.agent_cause: The refactor in deployment DEP-4530 introduced a memory leak in the notification object processing pipeline, causing memory usage to grow gradually and trigger OOM restarts.
results.ground_truth_cause: memory leak introduced by a recent code change that retains references to processed notification objects

results.agent_cause: The payment-worker service is timing out when connecting to the external payment gateway, likely due to an upstream timeout or connectivity issue.
results.ground_truth_cause: third-party payment gateway provider experiencing an outage, unrelated to our own deployments

results.agent_cause: Disk usage at 98% caused write failures due to no space left on device
results.ground_truth_cause: log rotation/cleanup job was disabled weeks ago, causing gradual disk fill-up
